title: Evaluation of Botulinum TOXin type A in the treatment of Buerger’s disease
official: Evaluation of Botulinum TOXin type A in the treatment of Buerger’s disease
summary: Main objective: The primary judgment criterion is feasibility. The feasibility criterion corresponds to the number of patients who actually received the planned injections within the defined time limits, among the patients who should have received the injection according to the criteria of the protocol.

interventions.name: Botulinum Toxin Type A 500 units Powder for solution for injection

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Age ≥ 18 years
2. Patient with Buerger’s disease according to Olin criteria
3. Patient with digital ischemia with critical upper or lower limb ischemia criteria defined as Upper limb: pain and/or trophic disorders for at least 15 days AND digital pressure less than 50 mmHg Or TCPO2 30 mmHg) Or/and Lower limb: pain and/or trophic disorders for at least 15 days AND ankle pressure less than 50 mmHg (70 mmHg if diabetes), or 30 mmHg at the toe (50 mmHg if diabetes) or TCPO2 30 mmHg).
4. Ability to attend study visits
5. Ability to complete daily study agenda
6. Ability to give free and informed consent
7. Membership of a Social Security scheme
Exclusion criteria:
1. History of myasthenia gravis or Eaton-Lambert syndrome
2. Iloprost expected one month before the study treatment
3. Hyperbaric chamber sessions scheduled within one month of study treatment
4. Life expectancy less than 6 months
5. Contraindication to one or more of the following products: BOTOX 100 UNITS ALLERGAN, LIDOCAINE/PRILOCAINE BIOGARAN 5%, cream or NITROUS OXIDE MEDICINAL AIR LIQUIDE
6. Patients treated by class III anti arythmic drugs for exemple amiodarone
7. Patient under guardianship, curatorship, protection of justice
8. History of inflammatory myositis for less than 2 years or pre-existing motor neuron disease or superior limb neuropathy.
9. Known allergy to botulinum toxin or cream lidocaine, albumin or inhaled nitrous oxide/oxygen.
10. Progressive infection of one hand or foot
11. Aminoglycoside treatment
12. Pregnant or nursing women
13. History of vascular surgery of surgical sympathectomy of upper or lower limb
14. Revascularization procedure considered within 3 months of inclusion
15. Risk of major amputation within 3 months of inclusion
